tasks.title: Add optional enum-constrained build_type to requirements schema
tasks.description: Add an optional build_type property to contracts/schemas/v1/requirements.schema.json, enum [game, cli, app, library, other]. The custom validator already enforces enum, so plan compile rejects an out-of-enum build_type while accepting requirements with no build_type. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: requirements.schema.json declares build_type as optional, enum-constrained to [game, cli, app, library, other].
plan compile rejects a requirements.json whose build_type is outside the enum, and still accepts one with no build_type.
A test covers both the valid-omitted and invalid-value cases; full suite passes.

tasks.title: Add scaffold-report schema and register it in doctor
tasks.description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/scaffold-report.schema.json (schema_version, project, build_type, template, generated_at, output_dir, rendered_files) and add 'scaffold-report' to REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES in cli/appbuilder.js so doctor verifies the schema file exists. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: scaffold-report.schema.json exists and validates a well-formed report object.
'scaffold-report' is in REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES and doctor passes with the schema present.
A test validates a sample report against the schema; full suite passes.

tasks.title: Author the cli build-type template
tasks.description: Create templates/cli/template.json (valid against template.schema.json, listing required_files) and templates/cli/files/ with package.json, README.md, .gitignore, src/index.js, test/index.test.js using {{slug}} and {{summary}} placeholders. Content authoring; a test asserts the manifest is valid and required_files match the files/ tree.
acceptance_criteria: templates/cli/template.json validates against template.schema.json and lists required_files.
templates/cli/files/ contains the listed files, using only the documented {{slug}}/{{summary}} placeholders.
A test asserts the manifest is valid and required_files match the files/ tree; full suite passes.

tasks.title: Implement the scaffold command
tasks.description: Add cli/lib/scaffold.js and dispatch `appbuilder scaffold <slug> [--force]` from the router (replacing the placeholder). Gate on compilePlan, require build_type present with an available template, copy templates/<build_type>/files/ into build/<slug>/ with {{variable}} substitution, assert required_files were produced, write+validate build/<slug>/scaffold-report.json. Scope the test runner to tests/ so generated stubs are not discovered. Refuse to overwrite build/<slug>/ unless --force. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: appbuilder scaffold <slug> renders templates/cli into build/<slug>/ with {{slug}}/{{summary}} substituted, and writes a valid scaffold-report.json.
scaffold gates on compile and fails clearly when build_type is missing or has no template; refuses an existing build/<slug>/ without --force and overwrites with it.
scripts.test is scoped to tests/ so generated build/<slug>/test stubs are not run; full suite passes and doctor is green.

tasks.title: Document the scaffold phase
tasks.description: Update README.md and HOWTO.md to document appbuilder scaffold: the build_type field, build/<slug>/ output, scaffold-report.json, and the loop position plan -> scaffold -> build. Docs only.
acceptance_criteria: README.md and HOWTO.md describe the scaffold command, build_type, build/<slug>/ output, and the loop position.
No scaffold workflow placeholder language remains where the command is now real.
